sampling.creator: YouTube recruited respondents through its creator community; Oxford checked for a mix of subscriber audience sizes, not a representative probability sample of all YouTube creators
sampling.user: Country surveys were recruited to represent age and gender in each country and weighted to characteristics of YouTube's user base
sampling.business: Firms using YouTube for video publishing, advertising or other business purposes; groups may overlap

definitions.creator: Person who uploads at least one YouTube video regardless of revenue
definitions.youtube_paid_creator: Creator receiving money directly from YouTube; excludes off-platform-only earnings
definitions.user: Person aged at least 18 who watches YouTube at least monthly
definitions.creative_entrepreneur: Individual or business with 10,000 or more subscribers on largest channel, or smaller creator with direct YouTube earnings, related off-platform earnings, or permanent employees

nested_jurisdictions.note: France and Germany are included within the EU27 geographic scope. Do not sum them with EU27 counts as independent population frames.

economic_impact.method: Oxford Economics models direct value added from associated revenue minus intermediate costs, then indirect and induced effects with input-output methods; U.S. uses IMPLAN
economic_impact.creator_revenue_sources: YouTube supplied aggregate 2025 platform payouts; off-platform revenues estimated from survey responses
economic_impact.fte_work_hours: Creative entrepreneurs' reported weekly YouTube work hours, filtered to those working at least eight hours; employee and supply-chain jobs additionally modeled

us_2025.unit: estimated GDP value added and supported full-time-equivalent jobs, not creator payments

cross_year_growth.reason: A strict lower bound in one year and a different strict lower bound the next do not determine actual year-over-year growth; model, sample and precision may differ.

interpretation_gates: Creator and business survey respondent counts are not population totals or independent creator/channel IDs.
EU27 overlaps France and Germany; do not sum the rows into a worldwide or European creator population.
YouTube-invited creator respondents are not a representative all-creator probability frame, and lack missing-channel and zero-earner denominators.
Gross economic contribution or employment supported is not a typical creator payout, personal income, net cash profit, or observed job headcount.
At-least-eight-hours filter excludes lower-hour creators from the reported creative-entrepreneur FTE calculation.
Do not derive hourly earnings from GDP/FTE or survey sample counts.
